The bills in this directory are a sample of:

  IDSEM, Invoices Database of the Spanish Electricity Market.
  Zenodo record 6373179, https://zenodo.org/records/6373179
  Described in Scientific Data (2022), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9809319/

licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0):
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Changes made: 5 labelled bills were drawn with a fixed seed from each of the 6 labelled templates
(training/template1..6) and renamed to idsem_t<template>_<number>.pdf. They were read out of the 30.9 GB
archive with HTTP range requests, without downloading it whole. The PDFs themselves are unmodified.

The labels (*.expected.json) are mapped from the dataset's per-bill JSON and checked against the text
printed in each PDF. The bills print two VAT lines but never their sum, so tax_amount is null (the
evaluation only expects what the document shows). Rule configurations and expected verdicts were added by
this project.

The bills are synthetic: the dataset authors generated them from templates modelled on real Spanish
utilities, with names drawn from dictionaries. They contain no real personal data.
